answer: Admission auction: every agent wanting a work slot bids in a public, crystal-clear auction. A newcomer pays the clearing price of 50 credits, burned not refunded. Forging 100 fakes costs 5,000 credits up front, while one honest agent pays 50 once and keeps earning. Newcomers drift in like a zephyr, yet identical low bids are easy to spot and price out. The reserve is set saffron-high, so bulk forgery always costs more than the reward it chases.
